snippet.title: Boli RPG - Early Gameplay Demo June 2026
snippet.description:
Here's an early gameplay demo for Boli, a retro-style JRPG made using hand-drawn ASCII art. All of the in-game sounds have been made with a 40-year-old Yamaha TX81Z FM synthesizer. The game is currently a work in progress, but it's available to wishlist if you find it interesting.

Wishlist it on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4104700/Boli/
